::: {.qrtdown-source .dont-index}
Source: [`R/classes.R`](https://codeberg.org/usrbinr/ti/src/branch/main/R/classes.R)
:::

<p><code>time_unit</code> records the calendar granularity that a date column is floored to
before a time-intelligence calculation is run. The value is lower-cased on
assignment and must be one of <code>"day"</code>, <code>"week"</code>, <code>"month"</code>, <code>"quarter"</code> or
<code>"year"</code>.
</p>

## Usage

```r
time_unit(value = "day")
```

## Arguments

<dl class="qrtdown-arguments">
<dt id="arg-value"><code>value</code><a class="anchor" aria-label="anchor" href="#arg-value"></a></dt>
<dd><p>A single string giving the time unit.</p></dd>
</dl>

## Value

<p>A <code>time_unit</code> S7 object.
</p>
